worst possible situation yet, somehow.

escaping trouble.

TEXT: [FI] Well, I'm grateful that you want to clean up, but...

TEXT:

are, but...

TEXT:

TEXT:

people's stuff like that, isn't that bad manners?

TEXT: [FI] Even when they're displayed boldly on your desk?

TEXT: [FI] Seriously though, isn't this an ero game?

TEXT: [FI] ...I gained a little more respect for you now.

TEXT:
[FI] Not "that so". Hey, I'll read it then? I'm gonna read 
the line depicted in that scene, okay?

TEXT: [FI] I'm not planning to read it all, you idiot!
